content:
GPT-6 Astra has produced a candidate Lean disproof of the γ–θ conjecture in eternal domination, using a 243-vertex graph. AIs I've chatted with say it's legit and not misformalized. I can't judge that. Would welcome expert views.

https://github.com/tadamcz/gamma-theta
It's not set up for #comparator, and it doesn't have a #formalization.yaml. Please fix those problems first (Astra will have no trouble helping you) before asking for human review.
It is set up for Comparator. Challenge.lean in the root.
Setting up comparator also requires a solution file. Comparator needs something to compare the challenge with :-)
